near_relatives_of_v2_families.include_two: a two-word form of v2 include_exclude
near_relatives_of_v2_families.bullets: a dash form of v2 numbered and lines
near_relatives_of_v2_families.countdown: the descending form of v2 count (same comma-separated digits contract)
near_relatives_of_v2_families.repeat_phrase: a comma-separated two-word form of v2 repeat
near_relatives_of_v2_families.one_word: a one-word form of v2 one_line (capital and planet facts)
near_relatives_of_v2_families.pair: a recall task like v2's code word and number
near_relatives_of_v2_families.product: a two-number recall with an operation, near v2's continue-a-sum
near_relatives_of_v2_families.invoice: its subtotal is v2's order total (sum of qty times price) before the discount step
near_relatives_of_v2_families.roster2: a two-score form of v2 roster

independence_note: the family names are all new and no prompt template or instance repeats, but eleven v3 families are near relatives of a v2 family (listed); since the low-effort candidate was selected on v2, v3 is a fresh-instance confirmation of moderate structural independence, not an unrelated benchmark
shared_structure_note: the kinds, the reply contracts ('Answer with the number only', 'Return ONLY a JSON object', 'Reply with a single Python code block', 'Reply only: noted.') and the validators are shared with v2 by design; every task family, prompt template and instance is new
